The technetium-99m scan () indicated that she had a slightly enlarged thyroid with an inhomogeneous uptake pattern (2.8%). Based on the above results, the patient was diagnosed as having autoimmune hemolytic anemia and Hashimoto's thyroiditis. Her HLA genotypes, HLA-A*020101/A*2602, HLA-B*270502/B*5401, HLA-Cw*0102/Cw*020202, HLA DRB1*0404/DRB1*0405, and DQB1*0302/DQB1*0401 were determined as previously described.
